decisions.decision: Reuse the kernel-checked prefix/window/suffix trace split as the sole endpoint-binding foundation.
decisions.reason: A local slide proof must be tied to the exact source and target trace windows; component IDs and a move name are insufficient.

decisions.decision: Build one shared source-bound attach-transport-detach movie interface, then instantiate it in order for one-over-one, two-over-one, and two-over-two.
decisions.reason: The three cases share endpoint binding and coupon transport; only the handle roles and exponent transport differ.

decisions.decision: Do not treat equality of differently parenthesized free diagram syntax as definitional equality.
decisions.reason: Reassembly is represented by explicit GeneratedIsotopy proofs, preserving the distinction between syntax and graphical isotopy.

decisions.decision: Project each dependent component correspondence through one shared edit-indexed helper before constructing the three request families.
decisions.reason: Lean correctly refused to identify proof-relevant values produced by two separate dependent pattern matches; the shared projection preserves the exact metadata and introduces no axiom or cast.

decisions.decision: Replace the three per-case term-window axioms by derived definitions specialized from one exact source-bound slide movie.
decisions.reason: All three handle roles now share the same trace binding and attach-transport-detach contract, while their request constructors keep the role-specific metadata and cycle transport explicit.

decisions.decision: Retain CanonicalSourceBoundSlideMovie.standardMovie as the single disclosed diagrammatic procurement boundary.
decisions.reason: The kernel proves every downstream specialization and evaluator consequence from this structured input, but it does not yet reconstruct ambient ribbon isotopy and coupon placement from raw planar coordinates.

validation.final_axiom_audit_observation: TwistedYetter and all three derived slide families depend on the one shared CanonicalSourceBoundSlideMovie.standardMovie axiom; the three former per-case term-window axioms are absent.
